title: Making $270,000/mo with AI?
description:
Everyone talks about ComfyUI workflows…

But who’s actually using it in the real world?

In this Short, I look at three companies using ComfyUI in production, from AI headshots to Netflix game development and large-scale immersive experiences.

I’m interested in practical AI, not hype.

💬 Know another company using ComfyUI? Drop it in the comments and I’ll investigate it in a future episode.

👍 Subscribe for more real-world AI tools and workflows for filmmakers and creators.

🌐 https://mikestaniforth.com

#ComfyUI #AI #OpenAI #Filmmaking #creativeai
